bio: A fun dining experience is guaranteed at this delightful restaurant with its inviting decor – the wine-glass chandeliers are certainly original! In the evening, there is a set menu comprising three, four or five courses, featuring dishes such as Appenzell mountain lamb and meat patties, served with green beans and chanterelles, thyme jus and Ribel polenta with mascarpone. There are also regular daily specials. Authentic Swiss cuisine based on craftsmanship, free from showmanship or trendy gimmicks – it resonates with locals and tourists alike. Well-curated wine list. In summer, the charming, spacious terrace beside the restaurant beckons. Each lunchtime brings a new selection of dishes to choose from....
